briefing.title: Mission Directive
briefing.threat: The Dark Miners have taken control of public ledgers. They use transparency as a weapon: they trace every transaction, identify every voter, and pressure those who do not align. Democracy is under siege.
briefing.mission: Our only defense is programmable privacy. Tools like witness and zero-knowledge proofs let us prove truth without revealing identity. Your mission is to infiltrate, master these technologies, and protect the vote of those who cannot defend themselves.
briefing.superior: I am your handler. I do not ask who you are; only that you deliver. Are you ready to operate in the shadows?
